label: Katana tasks
description: Katana sync jobs: stock from Katana, existing orders to Katana, or Swell products to Katana, run step by step

type.description: inventory: set Swell stock from all Katana inventory at the location; orders: send existing Swell orders to Katana; products: create Katana products for Swell products with stock tracking on, with starting stock

trigger.description: manual: started from the dashboard; schedule: started by the hourly stock sync

date_from.description: Orders only: send orders created on or after this date

page.description: Inventory: Katana inventory page the next step reads

last_id.description: Orders and products: ID of the last Swell record handled; the next step starts after it

checked.description: Katana items, Swell orders or Swell products looked at

changed.description: Swell stock levels changed, orders sent to Katana, or Katana products created (or given new variants)

skipped.description: Stock: items without SKU or with stock tracking off. Orders: nothing to ship. Products: items without a SKU

not_found.description: Katana SKUs with no Swell product or variant

duplicate_skus.description: Stock: Katana SKUs used by more than one Swell product or variant, so their stock isn't synced (up to 100)

failed.description: Orders or products Katana didn't accept (the error is saved on the record)

adjusted.description: Products: Katana variants whose starting stock was set from Swell

report.description: Swell stock levels changed by this stock sync, one row per product or variant (up to 2000 rows)

variant.description: Swell variant name, empty for a product without variants

change.description: Stock change in Swell (new level minus old level)

report_rows.description: Swell stock levels changed by this stock sync, including any beyond the 2000 rows kept

total.description: Orders or products to send, counted on the first step

retries.description: Automatic retries after rate limits or Katana errors

date_retry.description: When a waiting job is retried
